WITH invoice_counts AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
    FROM Orders o
    LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
), shares AS (
    SELECT order_id,
           invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share
    FROM invoice_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_number_of_invoices,
       a.avg_share AS average_share,
       AVG(s.invoice_share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE s.invoice_share > a.avg_share;
